subject: The left wedge was lost a THIRD time to parallel rewrites; restored onto the current corner-left architecture, and — per the owner's direction — gated by a new frontend contract test (tests/window-lights-contract.test.mjs, 7 checks) so every link of the chain fails loudly here instead of vanishing silently on the desktop
result: Owner report: left wedge gone again. DIAGNOSIS: the tree had moved again (HEAD now adf69204, the owner shell-behavior rulings doc) and yesterday evening's commits/merges dropped CradleFrame's windowLights signal AND reverted the hosted-app seam (hostedApp.ts right wedge + lights watcher, app.ts --shell-cutout-r, masthead right padding) — while KEEPING shell.css's data-window-lights reserve keys and the parallel session's own new corner regime (data-window-corner-left deriving the left cutout from the reserve; the per-mode stages and Workbench panes carry the attribute; the hairline-safe --window-corner-depth-left survived). With the signal gone the reserve sat at 42px → left cutout 0 → no wedge; right wedge lights-independent → survived. RESTORED on the CURRENT architecture: (1) CradleFrame signal + DesktopShell prop re-applied (derived-baseline + settle-ladder shape, unchanged); (2) hostedApp.ts shellCutout posts right again and the watcher watches data-window-lights; (3) expressions-app app.ts sets --shell-cutout-r and the masthead pads its end icons by it; expressions-app rebuilt. THE GATE (owner direction): new tests/window-lights-contract.test.mjs — 7 checks asserting every link: the derived-baseline signal (and that no direct setter reintroduces the stranded-sample shape), the DesktopShell prop + attribute, the shell.css reserve/offset keying, the corner-left cutout deriving from the reserve with the flush depth-left, the wedge actually carried by stages AND panes (the DESKTOP-LANGUAGE.md §5 ruling: not removed), and the hosted seam both wedges + lights re-post. Run it with the unit suites; a merge that eats any link now fails the suite instead of the owner's desktop. EVIDENCE: tsc clean; contract test 7/7; full unit suites 397/397 (the tree's suite has grown; the old forms.json red is resolved in current HEAD); expressions-app build clean; tauri rebuild; package sha256 826d71cb…; oi desktop remove+install; relaunched, verified running (pid 3714). STANDING RISK (unchanged): parallel sessions install from whatever the tree holds at their moment — if the wedge vanishes again, FIRST run node --test tests/window-lights-contract.test.mjs and oi desktop status: the test names the broken link; the sha names a stale install. Follow-up agent: verify the wedge live in windowed/fullscreen and through the fullscreen→sidebar-close→windowed sequence; keep the contract test green through future merges.
